clusters.headline: Centre Confirms Look Out Circular Issued Against Saurav Das
aiSummaryBullets: The Indian government confirmed to the Delhi High Court that a Look Out Circular has been issued against Saurav Das.
Authorities stated that document discrepancies, specifically concerning a passport, may impact his citizenship status.

clusters.headline: India Rejects US Manufacturing Claims Amid New Trade Tariff Threats
aiSummaryBullets: The United States has proposed a 25% tariff on Indian goods following a trade probe into manufacturing capacity.
Indian officials have officially denied allegations of excess manufacturing capacity in domestic sectors.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court To Review Tamil Nadu Karthigai Deepam Lamp Dispute
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court is set to hear petitions concerning a dispute over ritual lamp lighting at the Tirupparankundram site.
Tamil Nadu authorities have faced criticism and requests for a report from the governor regarding alleged non-compliance with court directives.

clusters.headline: Tata Trusts Challenges N Chandrasekaran Reappointment In Court
aiSummaryBullets: Tata Trusts filed a legal challenge in the Bombay High Court against the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as Tata Sons chairman.
The organization claims the reappointment process violates the internal Articles of Association of the company.

clusters.headline: Kallakurichi Police Serve Summons To TVK MLA Arul Vignesh In Case
aiSummaryBullets: Kallakurichi police delivered a summons to TVK MLA Arul Vignesh at his residence as part of an active investigation.
The state government established a four-member committee to investigate sexual harassment allegations against the MLA.

clusters.headline: PM Modi Criticises Opposition Over Reservation Policies On Constitution Day
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi commemorated Constitution Day while accusing opposition parties of attempting to reduce OBC quotas.
The Prime Minister alleged that the Congress party and its allies intend to divert reservation benefits toward minority communities.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Stays Allahabad HC Probe Order On Rahul Gandhi Assets
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court overturned an Allahabad High Court directive requiring federal agencies to probe assets linked to Rahul Gandhi.
The top court mandated that the Congress leader be formally added as a party in the ongoing High Court legal proceedings.

clusters.headline: Assam Man Rahul Roy Arrested For Alleged Rape Of Nine-Year-Old
aiSummaryBullets: Rahul Roy was apprehended by authorities in Assam after being accused of raping a nine-year-old child.
The suspect had reportedly established a rapport with the victim, who referred to him as 'Baba'.

clusters.headline: Amit Shah Discusses Security And Reopening The Kartarpur Corridor
aiSummaryBullets: Home Minister Amit Shah confirmed that plans to reopen the Kartarpur Corridor are currently under review.
The official stated that the reopening is contingent upon resolving existing national security concerns.

clusters.headline: Kerala High Court Denies Pre-arrest Bail To BLM Housing President
aiSummaryBullets: The Kerala High Court denied the pre-arrest bail plea filed by the former president of the BLM Housing Society.
Judges have recently weighed in on various matters, including juvenile maturity, witness protection, and high-profile corruption investigations.

clusters.headline: PM Modi Offers Rs 15,000 Crore Economic Package To Nepal Leader
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a meeting with Balen Shah to discuss bilateral relations.
The proposed economic package for Nepal is valued at Rs 15,000 crore.

clusters.headline: PM Modi Hailed For Venice Biennale Win As Constitution Day Marked
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recognized India's Venice Biennale pavilion victory while commemorating the nation's Constitution Day.
Diplomatic engagements include discussions with the German Chancellor regarding a pending free trade agreement between India and the European Union.

clusters.headline: Amul And Mother Dairy Milk Price Hike And Latest Market Updates
aiSummaryBullets: Tax authorities imposed a penalty for a cash-based property transaction between family members.
Insurance companies face rulings over compensation claims for vehicle damages and technical issues.

clusters.headline: Samajwadi Party And Congress Clash Over Uttar Pradesh Seat Sharing
aiSummaryBullets: Samajwadi Party offered Congress 26 assembly seats, a figure lower than expected, during alliance negotiations.
Congress leaders expressed frustration over the unilateral announcement of candidates and seat numbers by the Samajwadi Party.

clusters.headline: At Least 24 People Killed In Bus-Truck Collision In Assam State
aiSummaryBullets: A collision involving a bus and a truck occurred in Assam, India.
The incident resulted in at least 24 confirmed fatalities.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Quashes Case Against Rahul Gandhi Over Asset Claims
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India canceled Allahabad High Court directives that had requested probes by the CBI and ED into Rahul Gandhi's assets.
Rahul Gandhi recently alleged that his father, Rajiv Gandhi, had his security protection intentionally removed to facilitate his assassination.

clusters.headline: Sharad Pawar Admitted To Breach Candy Hospital In Mumbai Again
aiSummaryBullets: Sharad Pawar has been hospitalised at Breach Candy Hospital in Mumbai.
His daughter, Supriya Sule, stated that the politician is suffering from dehydration.

clusters.headline: Saurav Das To File Legal Complaints Following Passport Data Leak
aiSummaryBullets: Saurav Das, co-convenor of Citizens for Justice and Peace, intends to file criminal complaints regarding a recent data breach.
The incident occurred after his passport details were shared online following his inability to board a flight to London.

clusters.headline: West Bengal Cabinet Approves State Renaming To Paschim Banga
aiSummaryBullets: The West Bengal cabinet officially approved the proposal to rename the state to Paschim Banga in both Hindi and English.
Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari is scheduled to introduce the formal motion for this renaming process in the legislative assembly on December 9.

clusters.headline: New Reports Detail Chinese Satellite Activity During Operation Sindoor
aiSummaryBullets: Chinese satellites reportedly surveilled India's western coast and military sites during Operation Sindoor in 2022.
A US panel suggests China provided support to Pakistan during the operation to counteract India's regional influence.
